def solve_three_sat(instance) -> bool:
    """Yes iff some assignment satisfies every clause."""
    ThreeSat.validate(instance)
    m = instance["num_vars"]
    clauses = instance["clauses"]
    for bits in itertools.product([False, True], repeat=m):
